lines.text: The IMF says AI spending is propping up global growth.
lines.say: The IMF says AI spending is propping up global growth.

lines.text: Its October outlook sees world growth of 3.1% in 2026, up a tick from July.
lines.say: Its October outlook sees world growth of three point one percent in 2026, up a tick from July.
That's still slower than three point five percent in 2025.

lines.text: The drag? The IMF assumes oil averages $96 a barrel in 2026, up more than 40%.
lines.say: The drag? The IMF assumes oil averages ninety-six dollars a barrel in 2026, up more than forty percent.

lines.text: It also sees global inflation at 4.7% in 2026.
lines.say: It also sees global inflation at four point seven percent in 2026.

lines.text: The US is forecast to grow 2.3%, unchanged from July.
lines.say: The US is forecast to grow two point three percent, unchanged from July.

lines.text: But it flags risks: the Middle East war, an AI market correction, and rising debt.
lines.say: But it flags risks: the Middle East war, an AI market correction, and rising debt.

lines.text: For your money: big tech drives that AI spending, and it's a big piece of many 401(k) index funds. The IMF says rates may need to stay tight to tame inflation.

post.title: The IMF says AI spending is propping up global growth.
post.ig:
The IMF says AI spending is propping up global growth.
Its October 2026 outlook: world growth 3.1% in 2026, up from 3.0% in July but below 3.5% in 2025.
It assumes oil averages $96 a barrel in 2026 and sees global inflation at 4.7%.
The US is forecast to grow 2.3%, unchanged from July.
Sources: IMF World Economic Outlook (Oct 2026), AP, Reuters.
News and education, not financial advice.
